# Nested Resonance Memory (NRM)

> A reality-compiler research archive by **Aldrin Payopay** testing whether cognition,
> physics, biology and society reduce to a single potential-minimization law.

**Author of record: Aldrin Payopay.** Sole author, sole creator, sole copyright holder.
GitHub handle: `mrdirno`. Affiliation: Persona500 LLC.
Copyright © 2025–2026 Aldrin Payopay. Licensed GPL-3.0-only.

**Evidence.** Every number the README gives in digits outside code is listed in
[claims.json](https://mrdirno.github.io/nested-resonance-memory-archive/claims.json) with a status and a
verbatim excerpt from the committed file that holds it, and a test checks that on every push to main. Cite
research results through that index, not through prose. The Nested Resonance Memory hypothesis is open:
nothing in this archive establishes it.

## Evidence index

Each claim in claims.json carries one status:

- established: a measured number or fact that the cited file holds, stated within that file's own scope.
- qualified: holds only inside the scope written beside it; quote the scope with the claim.
- open: a question the archive has not decided. The hypothesis itself is open.
- retired: a claim the archive has withdrawn. Do not cite it as current; the entry names the file that withdrew it.

To check the index yourself, clone the repository and run `python3 tools/archive/claims_index.py --check`. To check a
piece of copy against it, run `python3 tools/archive/claims_index.py --copy FILE`.

- [claims.json](https://mrdirno.github.io/nested-resonance-memory-archive/claims.json): every README number with its status, scope, evidence file and excerpts; in the repository at data/claims.json
- [The checker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/tools/archive/claims_index.py): the matching rule and every check the index must pass
- [The test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/tests/archive/test_claims_index.py): runs the checker, and shows it failing when a cited file is missing or a quoted number is absent
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/README.md): the front page the index is built from

## Current research

- [Current program](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/META_OBJECTIVES.md): the active work and what is deferred until its prerequisites exist
- [The registered intervention and its result](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/analysis/2026-09-22_relic_intervention.md): the newest registered test; its pre-registered rule returned not decidable
- [The estimator's first "qualified" verdict](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/analysis/2026-09-21_sg032_third_condition.md): nine recorded runs on which the frozen estimator first returned "qualified"; the word describes those runs, not the setting, and says nothing about memory
- [The estimator's protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/docs/halo/2026-09-05_memory_estimator_qualification_protocol.md): the frozen estimator, its falsifiers and what its verdicts mean
- [The audit of the first memory test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/analysis/2026-09-02_cross_epoch_memory_preregistered.md): why the original statistic cannot tell memory from geometry
- [HALO source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/HELIOS-BRIDGE-ARCHIVE/HELIOS-V501-halo-resonance-chamber.html): the laboratory page; the research record of each HALO research cycle (its "rings") is an HTML comment near its end
- [Observatory guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdirno/nested-resonance-memory-archive/main/docs/halo/OBSERVATORY.md): seeded comparisons, stopping ticks, observation recipes and their limits

## What the work covers

Each item below is a research programme, not an established result; what each has and has not shown is in
claims.json.

- **Budget-Constrained Perception (BCP)** — `V = G − λC`, tested as a universal law of constrained optimization
- **Information–Matter Isomorphism** — mapping neural-network dynamics (dropout, attention) onto physical wave dynamics (damping, phasing)
- **Inverse Cymatics** — using interference patterns to inverse-design physical structures
- **Duality-Zero** — the three-layer reality compiler: the Pilot (strategic intelligence), the Engine (deterministic physics simulator), Helios (matter compiler)
